geography: Mysuru city and nearby localities, Karnataka, India
important_caveats: This is a best-effort directory compiled from public listings, not a certified complete list of every private ambulance operator in Mysuru.
A separate business listing does not prove that a provider is legally independent of hospitals or has no hospital tie-ups. Hospital affiliation is not established from the cited public sources.
Some Justdial numbers are directory call-routing numbers and may not be the operator's direct phone number.
Historical numbers from the 2015-16 Mysuru District Disaster Management Plan are old leads only and must not be treated as active contacts.
A public listing does not prove real-time ambulance availability, vehicle type, crew credentials, service radius or response time.
Do not show unverified providers as confirmed or available in a patient-facing app. Keep a manual verification and approval step before enabling dispatch.
